title: Health Cover FD - Eligible Age Criteria
text: The eligible age criteria of the primary holder (Resident individual) of the FD shall be between 18 years to 59 years.

title: Health Cover FD - Minimum and Maximum FD Amount
text: The minimum amount of the FD is Rs 5 lacs and maximum amount of the FD is Rs 1.99 cr.

title: Health Cover FD - Tenure
text: The tenure for the FD is Min 1 year and Max 120 months.

title: Health Cover FD - Hospital Cash Cover Amount
text: The Hospital Cash Cover offered shall be dependent on principal amount of the FD. Hospital Cash cover Rs 500 per day for 15 days: FD amount >=5 lacs to < 10 lacs and Hospital Cash cover Rs 1000 per day for 15 days: FD amount >= 10 lac to 1.99 cr.

title: Health Cover FD - Complimentary Coverage Period
text: The Complimentary Hospital Cash Cover is applicable only for 1st year of the Fixed Deposit tenure.

title: Health Cover FD - Policy Cancellation Conditions
text: The complimentary policy (Group Hospital Cash Cover) issued in my favour shall be cancelled upon premature/partial liquidation of FD principal amount >=50% of the total FD booked by me. Also, if the same is force closed by the bank due to non-servicing of OD against FD.

title: Health Cover FD - Mandatory Nomination
text: Nomination in the FD and Hospital Cash Cover (policy) is mandatory. If nominee is minor, guardian/appointee details should be shared and guardian/appointee should not be a minor.

title: Health Cover FD - One Policy Per FD
text: Customer can avail only one Hospital Cash Cover (Policy) against each FD per cust id. New Hospital Cash Cover (Policy) against the FD can be availed only after a year from premature withdrawal/closure/maturity of the earlier FD.

title: Health Cover FD - Primary Holder Only
text: Hospital Cash Cover will be applicable only to the primary holder of the FD.

title: Health Cover FD - Personal Details Change Impact
text: If a primary applicant changes the date of birth, name etc after HealthCover fd is booked and if the details are not as per the eligibility defined for the product, claim will not be settled for such cases.

title: Health Cover FD - Policy Renewal Details
text: The details for the renewal of the Hospital Cash Cover (Policy) for the subsequent year (i.e. 2nd year onwards) shall be shared by the concerned Insurance company on or before the expiry of the Policy.

title: Health Cover FD - Dispute and Grievance Redressal
text: For any dispute/grievances in relation to the Hospital Cash Cover, Customer to contact the Insurance Company for grievance redressal.

title: Health Cover FD - Policy Queries Contact
text: For any queries related to the policy, customer can write to the Insurance Company (ABHI) or visit nearest branch.

title: Health Cover FD - Claim Queries Contact
text: For any queries related to the claim, customer can write to the Insurance Company (ABHI).

title: Health Cover FD - TDS Applicability
text: TDS will be applicable on these FDs as per the extant statutory guidelines.

title: Health Cover FD - General FD Terms Applicability
text: All terms and conditions with respect to FD will be applicable.

title: Health Cover FD - Age Change Between Consent and Commencement
text: The eligible age criteria of the primary holder of the FD shall be between 18 years to 59 years. In the event of the change in age of member between the date of receipt of member consent and the risk commencement date, the Hospital Cash Cover of the member shall be provided as per the age on the risk commencement date.

title: Health Cover FD - Coverage Termination
text: The coverage shall terminate if you fail to satisfy any of the eligibility criteria, if you cease to be a member of the group for whatsoever reason or your relationship ceases with the master policy holder or if the premium is not paid within the allowed premium payment period.

title: Health Cover FD - Nominee Details Applicability
text: Nominee details updated are applicable only for current Policy being issued in the name of the primary holder.

title: Health Cover FD - Resident to Non-Resident Status Change
text: On change of status i.e. from resident to non-resident, benefits of HealthCover FD will be discontinued and HealthCover FD will have to be closed.

title: Health Cover FD - Personal Details Change Impact (Reiterated)
text: If a primary applicant changes the date of birth, name etc after HealthCover fd is booked and if the details are not as per the eligibility defined for the product, claim will not be settled for such cases.

title: Health Cover FD - Hospitalization Claim Limit
text: Benefits under hospital cash shall not be payable for more than 15 days per Hospitalization claim per Policy Year.

title: Health Cover FD - Annual Benefit Limit
text: Benefits under hospital cash shall not be payable for more than 15 days per Policy Year.

title: Health Cover FD - Deductible Period
text: Benefits under hospital cash will trigger only after a Deductible of 1 day.

title: Health Cover FD - Specified Disease/Procedure Waiting Period
text: A waiting period of 24 months from the Inception Date shall apply to the treatment, whether medical or Surgical and of the Illness/conditions and their complications mentioned in Annexure I.

title: Health Cover FD - Pre-Existing Diseases Waiting Period
text: Payment will not be done for any claim in respect of any Insured Person directly or indirectly caused by, based on, arising out of, relating to or howsoever attributable to any Pre-Existing Diseases or any complication arising from the same, until 4 years in this regard has elapsed since the Start Date of the first Policy with Us.

title: Health Cover FD - Initial Waiting Period
text: A waiting period of 30 days from the Inception Date of the Policy will be applicable for all Hospitalisation claims except in case of Accidents.

title: Health Cover FD - Permanent Exclusions
text: Aditya Birla Health Insurance company shall not be liable to make any payment for any claim under any Benefit in respect of any Insured Person directly or indirectly caused by, based on, arising out of, relating to or howsoever attributable to any of the reasons mentioned in Annexure II.

title: Good Health Declaration - Cardiovascular Conditions
text: I/We declare that I/We are not suffering from or have been diagnosed with, advised, taken treatment or observation for: High Blood Pressure, Heart Attack or any other Heart Disease, abnormal lipid levels.

title: Good Health Declaration - Cerebrovascular Conditions
text: I/We declare that I/We are not suffering from or have been diagnosed with, advised, taken treatment or observation for: Stroke, Paralysis in any form, or any other Cerebrovascular Disease.

title: Good Health Declaration - Endocrinal and Kidney Diseases
text: I/We declare that I/We are not suffering from or have been diagnosed with, advised, taken treatment or observation for: Diabetes or thyroid/parathyroid or any other Endocrinal Disease, Any Kidney Disease.

title: Good Health Declaration - Liver and Pancreatic Diseases
text: I/We declare that I/We are not suffering from or have been diagnosed with, advised, taken treatment or observation for: Acute/Chronic Liver (Failure/Disease), Cirrhosis of Liver, Alcoholic liver disease; any pancreatic disease.

title: Good Health Declaration - Lung Diseases
text: I/We declare that I/We are not suffering from or have been diagnosed with, advised, taken treatment or observation for: Any Lung Disease (e.g. Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Diseases, Parenchymal lung Disease, Pulmonary Embolism etc.).

title: Good Health Declaration - Blood, GI and Musculoskeletal Disorders
text: I/We declare that I/We are not suffering from or have been diagnosed with, advised, taken treatment or observation for: Blood Disorders, Gastro-Intestinal Diseases, Ulcer or any other disorder of the bones, spine or muscle.

title: Good Health Declaration - Cancer
text: I/We declare that I/We are not suffering from or have been diagnosed with, advised, taken treatment or observation for: Any Cancer or Cancerous growth.

title: Good Health Declaration - Mental and Neurological Conditions
text: I/We declare that I/We are not suffering from or have been diagnosed with, advised, taken treatment or observation for: Any Mental or Psychiatric condition, any Genetic Disease, autoimmune or any disease related to central nervous system (disease related to brain); Congenital conditions.

title: Good Health Declaration - HIV/AIDS
text: I/We declare that I/We are not suffering from or have been diagnosed with, advised, taken treatment or observation for: HIV/AIDS or AIDS related complications.

title: Good Health Declaration - COVID-19
text: I/We declare that I/We are not suffering from or have been diagnosed with, advised, taken treatment or observation for: Covid positive in last 3 months.

title: Good Health Declaration - Sudden Weight Loss
text: I/We declare that I/We are not suffering from or have been diagnosed with, advised, taken treatment or observation for: Any h/o sudden loss of weight in last 1 yr.

title: Health Cover FD - Declaration Accuracy and Policy Void Condition
text: I have read, understood and agree the above Terms and Conditions and I/We further agree and confirm if any of the above declarations are untrue or there has been any non-disclosure of any material fact, then the Policy to be issued by the insurer in my name shall be treated as void during the settlement of the said Policy by the Insurer.

title: Health Cover FD - Insurance Company Role Acknowledgment
text: I have read, understood and agree Health insurance product (Group Hospital Cash) belongs to insurance company (Aditya Birla Health Insurance) and the claim settlement will be as per Insurer's process and Bank does not have any role to play in the same.

title: Health Cover FD - Data Privacy Notice
text: I have read and agree to data privacy notice updated on HDFC Bank's website: www.hdfc.bank.in > Personal > Useful Links > Privacy.
